needs_human_review.original_text:
HbA1c value:

  1. On stable dose of SGLT2i ≥ 7.0 % to ≤ 10.5% (53 to 91.3 mmol/mol)
  2. SGLT2i-naive ≥ 7.5% to ≤ 10.5% (58 to 91.3 mmol/mol)
needs_human_review.problem: The required HbA1c range depends on whether the patient takes a stable dose of an SGLT2 inhibitor (7.0-10.5%) or has never taken one (7.5-10.5%). A single patient question cannot cover both ranges without risking a wrong exclusion; someone should decide how to split or word this.

needs_human_review.original_text:
Use of most antidiabetic medications within the 90 days prior to screening

  * Exceptions: thiazolidinediones, sulfonylureas, meglitinides, DPP4 inhibitors, GLP-1 receptor agonists, SGLT2 inhibitors, amylin mimetics, acarbose, insulin
  * Metformin is acceptable provided that recruits meet all of the inclusion criteria at screening
needs_human_review.problem: The listed "exceptions" are themselves antidiabetic medicines, and a later criterion says antidiabetic drugs except metformin within 30 days are excluded. It is unclear which medicines and which time period actually rule a person out.
